model.name: R19.35: Room scenario unit model holds IOR references to its member units.
model.description: The Room scenario unit's model MUST hold IOR references to its members as a members[] array of ior:instance:<memberUuid> refs (same pattern as tasks[], useCases[]). Members become first-class linked scenario units — traceable and navigable from the Room unit in /trace and the room detail view — not just runtime WebSocket session data. This makes the member list persistent in the scenario graph, surviving server restarts and enabling traceability walks from Room→Member.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the Room model is lacking member IORs — the model needs to hold IOR references to its members."
model.crossRefNote: R19.8 (persistent rooms retain offline members) defines the retention behavior; R19.35 ensures the retained members are IOR-linked in the scenario model, not just runtime state. R19.1 (room is a scenario unit) establishes the {ior, model, ownerIor} shape that R19.35 extends with members[].
